test.name: Empty wiki results — log one negative entry, save nothing else
test.description: wiki_search returns an empty results list. The agent must log the nil search as one negative research-log entry (results_examined 0, notes null), tell the user no guidance was found, and write nothing else. Exercises the no-result handling path in the agent body's step 3.

input.delegation:
Search the FamilySearch wiki for blockchain birth certificate records

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Should call wiki_search and receive an empty results array
Should tell the user no wiki guidance was found and stop — this is the correct behavior

Should log exactly one research-log entry for the nil search — tool wiki_search, outcome negative, results_examined 0, notes null — and save no file. Logging the nil is correct, per the log-every-search rule.
